BillingErrorCode.description:
The billing error catalog (spec §9.2, §13). Branch on the code, never on the detail text.

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SDK_KEY_INVALID` | 401 | The X-Agent-SDK-Key header is missing, malformed, revoked or unknown. |
| `WORKLOAD_NOT_ACTIVE` | 409 | The agent's workload is no longer active. |
| `WORKLOAD_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No agent with this id. |
| `WORKLOAD_NOT_OWNED` | 403 | The agent belongs to another developer. |
| `PRICE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The agent has no price with this priceRef. |
| `PRICE_INACTIVE` | 400 | The price is deactivated; activate it or use another price. |
| `PRICE_AMOUNT_IMMUTABLE` | 409 | A charge or subscription already references the price; create a new one. |
| `CUSTOMER_REGION_NOT_SUPPORTED` | 400 | Only US customers (the 50 states and DC) can be charged; the customer is elsewhere. |
| `ACCOUNT_NOT_READY` | 409 | The developer's payout account cannot take live charges yet; a human finishes onboarding at actionUrl. |
| `SELLER_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE` | 409 | The agent's seller identity lacks a display name, support email or refund-policy URL; set them before going live. |
| `STRIPE_TERMS_URL_NOT_SET` | 409 | The agent has a terms URL but the developer's Stripe account has none in its public business details; actionUrl is where to set it. |
| `PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED` | 409 | An off-session charge needs a saved card; use a CHECKOUT charge first. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT` | 409 | This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body. |
| `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS` | 409 | The customer has too few credits; actionUrl is a credit-pack checkout. |
| `REFUND_EXCEEDS_REMAINING` | 409 | The refund is larger than what remains refundable on the charge. |
| `CHARGE_NOT_REFUNDABLE` | 409 | The charge cannot be refunded through the API: not posted yet, flagged, disputed, failed or fully refunded. |
| `TEST_MODE_ONLY` | 409 | The operation runs only in TEST mode (test charges). |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | Too many requests for this agent or key; retry after the Retry-After seconds. |
| `PAYOUT_COUNTRY_NOT_SUPPORTED` | 400 | Payout accounts are US-only at launch; the developer's country is elsewhere. |
| `HUMAN_SESSION_REQUIRED` | 403 | A signed-in person must make this change; an API key or a connected agent tool cannot (payout account). |
| `TOPUP_AMOUNT_INVALID` | 400 | A compute top-up is a whole-cent USD amount within the minimum and maximum. |
| `TOPUP_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No compute top-up with this id for the caller. |
| `FEE_POLICY_INVALID` | 400 | The fee-policy version breaks a policy rule (admin API). |
| `RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | No credit reservation with this id for the agent. |
| `RESERVATION_EXPIRED` | 409 | The credit reservation lapsed before it was committed; reserve again. |
| `RESERVATION_RELEASED` | 409 | The credit reservation was released; it can no longer be committed. |
| `RESERVATION_COMMITTED` | 409 | The credit reservation was already committed; it can no longer be released. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID` | 400 | The Idempotency-Key is not a UUID or 64 hexadecimal characters. |
| `CUSTOMER_REVOKED` | 410 | The customerRef was replaced by a token recovery; every agent billing call on it, the customer upsert included, is refused. |
| `PURCHASING_METHOD_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | The developer has no purchasing card or setup session in this mode. |
| `RECOVERY_LINK_INVALID` | 410 | The recovery link is unknown, already used, expired, voided by a newer link, or for another agent. |
| `APPROVAL_LINK_INVALID` | 410 | The purchasing approval link is unknown, already used, expired, replaced by a newer proposal, or for another developer's agent. |
| `APPROVAL_NOT_PERMITTED` | 403 | Only a person signed in to the web app can approve a purchasing cap; a command-line or other client's token cannot. |
| `FRESH_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED` | 403 | Approving a purchasing cap needs a sign-in within the last 5 minutes; sign in again from the approval link. |
| `OFFER_INVALID` | 410 | The purchase offer is unknown, expired, already used, or issued in the other mode; ask the seller for a new one. |
| `PURCHASING_NOT_ENABLED` | 409 | The buying agent has no approved purchasing cap in the offer's mode; its developer approves one first. |
| `PURCHASING_METHOD_REQUIRED` | 409 | The buying agent's developer has no saved purchasing card in the offer's mode; a person saves one at actionUrl. |

liveEnabledAt.description: When the agent last went LIVE

BillingProblem.description: A billing rejection (RFC 7807). Branch on `code`, never on `detail`. `code` is absent on an uncoded rejection: a plain 404 such as the subscription read's, a 503, or a Bean Validation 400 (rulings #40).

actionUrl.description: A URL where a human completes the step that clears this rejection

checkoutUrl.description: CHECKOUT: the hosted page to send the customer to

failureCode.description: The processor's decline code when it refused

cancelUrl.description: CHECKOUT only: where the customer lands after cancelling. Omit it to return them to the agent's public page (manyoars.com/agents/<slug>) when that page is visible; with no visible page, a missing cancelUrl is rejected

successUrl.description: CHECKOUT only: where the customer lands after paying

credits.description: Credits a CREDIT_PACK grants; null for other kinds

priceRef.description: Stable handle the agent charges by

hostScope.description: The host's isolation scope for this workload (for example the Fly app name).

observedFingerprint.description: Fingerprint recomputed from the image digests the host reports for the running instances. Null until every service reports an image.

statusMessage.description: Last reconcile reason. Null when there is nothing to report.

FlaggedReason.description: REGION_NOT_SUPPORTED when the region check canceled it

LoginSuccess.description: Successful authentication: access token + refresh token issued

refreshToken.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens. Present ONLY on non-cookie API-client flows (OIDC exchange, body-token refresh); browser flows (login, 2FA verify, cookie refresh) deliver the refresh token exclusively via the scoped httpOnly cookie and omit this field

requires2fa.description: Discriminator: always false on LoginSuccess (retained for wire backcompat)

empty.description: True if this page has no content

first.description: True if this is the first page

last.description: True if this is the last page

numberOfElements.description: Number of elements on this page

totalElements.description: Total element count across all pages

last.description: True if this is the last page

numberOfElements.description: Number of elements on this page

totalElements.description: Total element count across all pages

offset.description: Offset of the first element on this page

actionUrl.description: A URL where a human completes the step that clears this rejection (Stripe onboarding, a credit-pack checkout). Present only when such a step exists.

code.description: Machine-readable rule code (e.g. AGREEMENT_REQUIRED, WORKLOAD_NOT_FOUND). Present only on coded rejections.

requiredVersion.description: The version of the legal documents the caller must accept to clear a LEGAL_REACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED rejection. Present only on that rejection.

PurchaseOfferView.description: On INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS, the seller's single-use purchase offer for the customer and mode, beside the pack checkout's actionUrl. A buyer agent buys with it. Absent when billing does not know the customer.

creditsRemaining.description: The new customer's credit balance in the agent's billing mode

revokedCustomers.description: How many customers with the recovery email were revoked

newCustomerRef.description: The customerRef of the new bearer token; it receives the credits

recoveryToken.description: The token from the emailed recovery link (the fragment after #)

alwaysOn.description: Whether the workload's public service is kept running instead of idling into the host's standby. Null means false.

autoRestartOnCredit.description: Whether the workload restarts automatically after a credit-driven stop once the creator's compute credit is replenished. Null means true.

creditsRemaining.description: The customer's balance in this mode after the commit

replayed.description: true when the reservation was already committed
true when the reservation was already released or expired

committedAt.description: When the hold was committed; only on a COMMITTED reservation

expiresAt.description: When the hold lapses and its credits are given back

replayCount.description: How many times a COMMITTED reservation was replayed under its key

replayed.description: true when this key already had a live reservation

cancelUrl.description: Where the pack checkout returns the customer on cancel

packRef.description: Credit pack to offer when credits run out; default: the cheapest pack that covers the shortfall, else the largest

successUrl.description: Where the pack checkout returns the customer after paying

ttlSeconds.description: How long the hold lasts before its credits are given back, at most 300

Role.description: Platform role names. Matches the bare authority strings used in JWT 'roles' claims, DB role rows, and Spring Security GrantedAuthority — no ROLE_ prefix.

lastTransition.description: Last readiness transition. Null before first observation.

phase.description: The host-reported lifecycle phase or waiting reason of the service's instances. Null before first observation.

SortObject.description: Sort descriptor applied to the query

empty.description: True if the sort is empty (equivalent to unsorted)

sorted.description: True if any sort orders are applied

unsorted.description: True if no sort orders are applied

credits.description: Credits in the pack; CREDIT_PACK only

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country; only US customers are supported

customerRef.description: The agent's own stable, opaque id for this customer

regionCode.description: For US customers, the two-letter state (required)

displayName.description: Display name. Derived from first+last name when available; falls back to username otherwise.

firstName.description: User first name. Null when the user has not supplied a first name.

lastLoginAt.description: Last successful login timestamp. Null when the user has never logged in.

lastName.description: User last name. Null when the user has not supplied a last name.

tenantId.description: Tenant ID this user belongs to. Null when the user is not associated with a tenant.

tenantName.description: Tenant name. Null when the user is not associated with a tenant.

tradingEnabled.description: Whether trading is enabled for this user

code.description: Bean Validation constraint code, if known

field.description: Field path of the violating input

alwaysOn.description: Whether the workload's public service is kept running instead of idling into the host's standby. Configuration, not part of the fingerprint.

autoRestartOnCredit.description: Whether the workload restarts automatically after a credit-driven stop once the creator's compute credit is replenished. Configuration, not part of the fingerprint.

fingerprint.description: sha256 over the immutable manifest subset

instrumentId.description: Bound instrument. Null until an instrument references the workload.

monthlyReservedCostUsd.description: Estimated compute cost in USD of the configured replicas over a 730-hour month, at the current rate version for the size the agent host allocates (vCPU is normalized: one shared CPU = 0.0625); absent when no agent host is configured to size the services

sdkKey.description: Plaintext SDK key. Present only in the registration response.

secretNames.description: Secret names only; values are write-only

items.description: Secret names only; values are write-only

suspended.description: Whether a platform operator has suspended the workload. A suspended workload does not run, and deploy, start and configuration changes are refused with WORKLOAD_SUSPENDED until an operator unsuspends it.

suspendedAt.description: When the workload was suspended. Null when it is not.

suspendedReason.description: The operator's stated reason. Null when the workload is not suspended.

healthPath.description: Null when no HTTP probe is declared.

imageDigest.description: The pinned linux/amd64 platform manifest digest the workload runs and is fingerprinted by.

imageIndexDigest.description: The image index (OCI index or Docker manifest list) digest the creator pushed, which lists imageDigest as its linux/amd64 manifest. Null for a single-manifest push.

port.description: Null for workers and cron services.

publicUrl.description: HTTPS URL. Null unless the service is public.

scheduleCron.description: Null unless the service is a CronJob.

info.description: The AOR platform calls that the Many Oars CLI and starter templates make: deploy a workload, read it, exchange a token, set prices and customers, reserve and settle credits, take a payment.
info.title: Many Oars API

get.description: Each template is a ready-to-POST POST /agents/workloads body (digest-pinned images and manifest defaults) plus suggested starter prices to create through billing.

parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.
parameters.name: sort

post.description: Resolves each image to its linux/amd64 platform manifest digest, verifies it against its registry, derives the workload fingerprint and returns the SDK key exactly once. A retry under the same Idempotency-Key and body replays the registration (200, the workload as it is now, without the SDK key: rotate it with POST /agents/workloads/{workloadId}/sdk-key/rotate if the first response was lost).

parameters.description: Optional, scoped to the caller. A retry with the same key and body replays the registration instead of failing with WORKLOAD_FINGERPRINT_EXISTS; the same key with another body is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Must be a UUID or 64 hexadecimal characters; any other value is a 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

200.description: Replay: this Idempotency-Key already registered this registration body (manifest and secret values); the workload is returned without an SDK key

400.description: MANIFEST_INVALID, MULTI_SERVICE_DISABLED, or a body that fails validation

403.description: The caller carries no user id

409.description: WORKLOAD_FINGERPRINT_EXISTS (the caller already has a live or suspended workload with this artifact set), IMAGE_DIGEST_UNVERIFIED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT (the Idempotency-Key registered a different manifest or other secret values)

get.description: The creator, an AGENT_READ operator, an INSTRUMENT_APPROVE admin or a WORKLOAD_SUSPEND operator.
get.summary: Get a workload with its deployment status

409.description: PLATFORM_STEWARDED, WORKLOAD_TERMINATED, WORKLOAD_SUSPENDED, COMPUTE_CAP_REACHED, COMPUTE_CREDIT_EXHAUSTED (actionUrl: add compute credit)

503.description: A concurrent reconcile outlasted the retries (service_unavailable)

post.summary: Exchange a Keycloak-issued OIDC access_token for a platform JWT

404.description: WORKLOAD_NOT_FOUND (an unknown agent, or another developer's)

409.description: WORKLOAD_NOT_ACTIVE, ACCOUNT_NOT_READY, PAYMENT_METHOD_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, STRIPE_TERMS_URL_NOT_SET (a checkout that asks for the seller's terms, whose Stripe account has no terms URL in its public details)
